explicit_overlap_reconciliation.law: Book orchestrator selects/routes specialist work. Prose internal orchestration may coordinate only Prose-owned literary stages after invocation. Neither writes canonical manuscript; Book admission does.
Story Bible owns canon truth. Prose consumes canon context and emits preservation evidence; it does not create/retcon canon.
Evaluator acceptance is one possible evidence input. Book admission evaluates all applicable evidence/authority and alone may create canonical effect.
Book author-decision receipts remain canonical decision evidence. Prose may append project-specific derived learning references; it cannot rewrite or replace Book decision history.
